content: Good afternoon, this is Career Connect. How can I assist you with your career planning today?
Hi, I've been feeling really stuck and uncertain about my current job path. I'm not sure if I'm making the right choices.
I understand how challenging that can feel. I reassure you that you're not alone in this, and I'm here to help you explore your options thoughtfully and confidently.
That means a lot to hear. I'm worried that any change I make might set me back instead of moving forward.
Don't worry ,  together, we'll approach this step by step. You can trust me to guide you through a clear plan that fits your skills and goals.
Okay, that sounds reassuring. What would be the first step you suggest?
First, we'll review your current strengths and interests to identify suitable paths. I'll support you through this process, ensuring you feel confident at each stage.
Thanks, I appreciate the support. I'm ready to take that first step now.
